description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act No. 48 of 2007, Order under Section 5, Rs. 05 per kg., on importation of rice shall be collected for a period of 30 days from 27.02.2017
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Ravi Karunanayake) and detailed portfolio responsibilities (Minister of Finance). It also includes specific regulatory action (waiving and setting a commodity levy) under his ministerial authority, making it a Hybrid gazette that combines both personnel and detailed governmental responsibilities.
